title: Deeper/broader peer proxy payload, display-graphics, and DWG coverage review
mode: Primary-source cross-project contract review and local source/test-coverage audit; plan-only update
scope: Refresh merged status and exact revision of ACadSharp PR #1274
Compare DWG unknown-class retention/maturity boundaries documented by LibreDWG
Compare DXF ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY data versus display-graphics/explode semantics documented by ezdxf
Separate raw DWG proxy-data retention, saved graphics, vendor semantics, and DXF replay
Compare the peer capability against libdxfrw DWG proxy parser/dispatch and generated test inventory
Add a focused generated-frame test subplan without importing external DWG fixtures or adding a peer runtime

method.kind: Read primary project documentation, GitHub PR/commit pages, and local parser, dispatch, and test sources
method.limitations: ACadSharp contributor corpus results were not independently reproduced and no public hashes were provided. LibreDWG and ezdxf pages were source-reviewed only, not built or executed. No proxy DWG fixture was downloaded. Static local coverage review does not prove that the existing parser is wrong; ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for any generated DWG field layout.

sources.revision: Merged into DomCR/ACadSharp master as c9cb845 on 2026-10-13; page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The change reads retained proxy data into an IProxy.Data property by using the proxy field end and handle-section offset. The PR states that its offset is available for R2010+ and data remains unset earlier. The author reports 21 drawings, 1,607,215 entities, unchanged type/handle fingerprints, and 2,358 retained proxy bytes. No regression DWG/test was included because the examples were private/large.
sources.limits: Reported counts and data totals are not hash-bound or independently reproduced. This establishes a merged peer implementation route, not complete proxy semantics, DXF writer support, or a DWG specification rule for all versions.

sources.revision: Cross-linked from PR #1274; open in the reviewed page snapshot
sources.observed: The follow-up is a separate Tianzheng custom-payload interpretation route, distinct from retaining the opaque bytes.
sources.limits: One vendor-specific decoder does not define arbitrary proxy semantics or general class support.

sources.project: LibreDWG class maturity documentation and NEWS
sources.revision: Mutable master pages reviewed 2026-10-18; no local clone or immutable source SHA pinned
sources.observed: The manual distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled classes. It documents unknown-class fallback and same-version raw-blob rewrite constraints for some unstable classes, while unhandled classes are ignored. NEWS includes a proxy-object version-corruption fix in the JSON roundtrip route.
sources.limits: Peer class policy and bug history are not ODA rules and do not establish libdxfrw behavior. A mutable documentation snapshot is an advisory route comparison, not a reproducible runtime result.

sources.revision: Stable documentation identifies ezdxf 1.4.5; pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY stores original data and graphics but internals are unknown; exploding replaces the proxy with virtual graphics and loses original meaning. The ACIS tools state they are not a general arbitrary-ACIS editor or kernel, unsupported records can lose data, and flat-face mesh projection drops curved boundaries.
sources.limits: Documentation defines ezdxf's own DXF/ACIS route only. It does not say how libdxfrw behaves and cannot serve as a positive general proxy or ACIS semantic oracle.

sources.revision: Local worktree HEAD de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9; source reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: DRW_ProxyEntity::parseDwg captures a bounded entity-data bit range and object-ID references; dwgReader::readDwgEntity dispatches the proxy entity. Existing proxy tests cover DXF proxy entity/object payload grammar and DWG proxy-object/modeler paths, but no DWG test constructs a ProxyEntity frame or asserts that dispatch.
sources.limits: This is a source/test-inventory finding, not evidence of a production parse failure. A generated frame must follow ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.90 PROXY; the separate common proxy-graphics layout is in chapter 29. §20.4.95 is SPATIAL_INDEX.
